core.title: Mul-T-Lock #18 E-Series Extra Heavy Duty Padlock With 23/32 Shackle

text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock #18 E-Series Extra Heavy Duty Padlock With 23/32" Shackle And High Guard

The E-Series Line of MUL-T-LOCK Heavy Duty Padlocks is designed to offer the Highest Level of Padlock Protection available in the market today. All E-Series Padlocks are made of Boron Alloy, and can uphold to the most determined attempts of physical abuse. They are available with or without a Shackle Guard for extra protection. E-Series Padlocks are also available in Sliding Bolt Configuration (SBE) for superior shackle protection. When looking for the Ultimate in High Security Padlock Protection, the MUL-T-LOCK'S E-Series line of padlocks is your answer.

E-Series High Guard Specifications Diagram (PDF)

Features:

  • Hardened Boron Alloy Shackle, 23/32" Diameter
  • Hardened Boron Alloy Body
  • Drill and Pick Resistant Cylinder
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty

If you are purchasing multiple Mul-T-Lock padlocks we can key them Alike or key them Different
